announced on Wednesday that it had completed its acquisition of a 30% stake in MediaMeta.Ai, with an option to acquire a controlling interest.
The valuation remains unchanged, with deal consideration comprising 15% cash and 85% GMEX shares, subject to a 24-month lockup.
Upon closing, GMEX gained exclusive access to the technologies and platform that MediaMeta operates and develops.
MediaMeta’s social intelligence capabilities for robotics applications remain in development.
On the market side, the GMEX shares declined ~6.43% to ~$1.60 in the after-hours trading.

title: GMEX Robotics acquires 30% MediaMeta stake in cash-and-stock deal
